description: Selection-set policy applied uniformly by generate_provider.mjs via lib/schema_walk.mjs. The query text and the responses.200 schema are generated from the same resolved field list. Never hand-tuned per resource: every rule here applies to every resource.

rules.scalarAndEnumFields: select every field on the node type whose named type is a scalar or an enum, including lists of scalars/enums (projected as JSON arrays)
rules.excludeFieldsWithRequiredArgs: fields that declare one or more required arguments (non-null with no default) are not selectable bare and are excluded
rules.excludeFieldNamePatterns: fields whose name matches any of these regular expressions are excluded uniformly; the *Html fields are server-rendered duplicates of their markdown source fields and cost complexity and payload for no relational value
rules.nodeTypeFieldExclusions: per node type, named fields excluded so the generated query fits complexityBudget; derived by trim_to_budget.mjs from measured per-field costs (field_costs/<Type>.json): highest-cost unprotected fields first, with the evidence recorded alongside. Never hand-picked.
rules.nestedIdentity: for each node-type field named in nestedIdentityAllowlist whose type is a single (non-list) object, select the intersection of the allowlisted subfields that exist on that object type as scalars/enums; projected as a JSON object column
rules.columnCasing: every selected field is aliased in the query to its snake_case form (fullPath -> full_path), so response keys, the response schema and DESCRIBE all present snake_case columns without engine-side aliasing
rules.complexityBudget: the score every generated query must fit: the anonymous gitlab.com limit (200; the authenticated limit is 250) less a margin for measurement drift, so both anonymous and token-bearing callers are served
rules.budgetProtectedFields: fields never excluded by the budget trim, whatever their cost: identity, state, timestamps and the merge/approval state the documented queries depend on
rules.sqlReservedColumnNames: snake_case names the engine rejects as bare column identifiers (measured 2026-09-25 against stackql v0.12.718 with .scratch-style mock probes: the stackql parser rejects all/exists/from/group/limit/release/to and the SQLite stage rejects default/primary; neither double quotes nor backticks rescue them); such columns and parameters get reservedColumnSuffix appended (exists -> exists_, group -> group_)
rules.unstableFields: per node type, fields whose GitLab resolver has been observed to time out on large result sets (a GraphQL error fails the whole query, engine policy); excluded uniformly wherever the node type is selected, with the observation recorded

MergeRequest.evidence: measured 245 against budget 190 on 2026-09-25 via measure_field_costs.mjs (project.mergeRequests); highest-cost unprotected fields excluded until the projected score (187) fits

Project.containerRepositoriesCount: 2026-09-25: 'Timeout on Project.containerRepositoriesCount' from gitlab.com on group_projects for gitlab-org (thousands of projects); the per-project registry count resolver exceeds GitLab's field timeout under load and the error fails the whole page

Group.containerRepositoriesCount: same registry-count resolver as the observed Project.containerRepositoriesCount timeout, aggregated over every project in the group; excluded with it

CiRunner.jobCount: 2026-09-25: Project.runners on gitlab.com (shared fleet, 100 nodes) answers in 1 s with id/description/status and 'Request timed out' with jobCount projectCount added - per-runner aggregations over the shared fleet
CiRunner.projectCount: 2026-09-25: same probe as jobCount; the two together reproduce the timeout, the rest of the CiRunner selection does not
